Component kit

Every component of the design system, rendered live with the markup that produces it. Copy the pattern, change the content. Tokens and class vocabulary are in assets/css/site.css; behaviour is in assets/js/site.js.

00Tokens

  • --ink#0B1220
  • --ink-2#1B2536
  • --paper#F4F1EA
  • --paper-2#E9E5DA
  • --white#FFFDF8
  • --signal#FF4D1F · graphics, buttons
  • --signal-deep#BF300A · small text on paper
  • --trace#2FE0C2 · on dark only
  • --amber#FFB020 · diagrams only

Components never use the raw colours for text and rules: they use the semantic tokens --bg --fg --muted --rule --rule-strong --accent --surface, which .is-dark re-maps. Section backgrounds: .section (paper), .section--paper2, .section--white, .section.is-dark.instrument.

01Type scale

Archivo (display, wide), IBM Plex Sans (text), IBM Plex Mono (labels). Classes .display .h1–.h4 can be put on any element; .lead, .small, .muted, .measure, .hl (accent word), .pull (pull-quote).

Display 81

Heading one

Heading two

Heading three

Heading four

Lead paragraph. A trend tells you whether to act.

Body text in IBM Plex Sans with an accent word and Turkish glyphs: İ ı ğ ş ç ö ü — H2, C2H2.

Small muted text.

Periodic testing is a photograph. Monitoring is the film.

Markup
<p class="display">Display 81</p>
<h1 class="h1">Heading one</h1>
<h2>Heading two</h2>
<h3>Heading three</h3>
<h4>Heading four</h4>
<p class="lead measure">Lead paragraph. A trend tells you whether to act.</p>
<p class="measure">Body text in IBM Plex Sans with <span class="hl">an accent word</span> and Turkish glyphs: İ ı ğ ş ç ö ü — H<sub>2</sub>, C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>2</sub>.</p>
<p class="small muted">Small muted text.</p>
<p class="pull">Periodic testing is a photograph. Monitoring is the film.</p>

02Mono labels, section index, tags

.label is the datasheet voice. .sec-head + .sec-index gives every section its number and its node on the line.

03Why continuous

Section title, max 20ch.

Optional lead. Add .sec-head--split to put it in a right-hand column.

Label · muted

Label · foreground

Label · signal

  • Tag
  • Link tag
  • Quiet
  • Solid
  • Signal
  • Per manufacturer data

<div class="sec-head">
  <p class="sec-index"><span class="sec-index__n">03</span>Why continuous</p>
  <h2 class="sec-head__title">Section title, max 20ch.</h2>
  <p class="lead">Optional lead. Add .sec-head--split to put it in a right-hand column.</p>
</div>
<p class="label">Label · muted</p>
<p class="label label--fg">Label · foreground</p>
<p class="label label--signal">Label · signal</p>

  <li><a class="tag" href="#">Link tag</a></li>
  <li class="tag tag--quiet">Quiet</li>

</ul>

.btn--primary (one per view), .btn--ink, .btn--ghost, .btn--sm, .btn--block. Text links: .link-arrow, .link-inline. The arrow is the partial {{> arrow}}.

04Dark instrument context

Add .is-dark to any block: every component re-maps its colours. .instrument adds the dotted graph ground. .is-light re-enters paper.

Trace label

Components adapt on dark.

Muted text, rules, buttons and tags all follow the semantic tokens.

Primary Ghost In service
Markup
<div class="is-dark instrument" style="padding:32px">
  <p class="label label--trace">Trace label</p>
  <h3 class="mt-4">Components adapt on dark.</h3>
  <p class="muted mt-4 measure-s">Muted text, rules, buttons and tags all follow the semantic tokens.</p>
  <div class="btn-row mt-5">
    <a class="btn btn--primary" href="#">Primary{{> arrow}}</a>
    <a class="btn btn--ghost" href="#">Ghost</a>
    <span class="tag tag--live">In service</span>
  </div>
</div>

06Datasheet card (product block)

Always carries the “Per manufacturer data” tag. .datasheet--wide puts head and specs side by side; .ticks adds corner marks.

Product · Megger

InsuLogix® G2

Online monitor for hydrogen, acetylene and moisture in transformer oil.

Detection limits
25 ppm H2 · 0.5 ppm C2H2 · 2 ppm moisture
Mounting
Single 38 mm (1.5 in) valve

Per manufacturer data

Two-gas monitor · not a replacement for laboratory DGA

Markup
<article class="datasheet datasheet--wide ticks">
  <header class="datasheet__head">
    <div class="stack">
      <div class="datasheet__meta"><p class="label">Product · Megger</p></div>
      <h3 class="datasheet__name">InsuLogix® G2</h3>
      <p class="datasheet__desc">Online monitor for hydrogen, acetylene and moisture in transformer oil.</p>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="datasheet__body">
    <dl class="spec">
      <div class="spec__row"><dt>Detection limits</dt><dd>25 ppm H<sub>2</sub> · 0.5 ppm C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>2</sub> · 2 ppm moisture</dd></div>
      <div class="spec__row"><dt>Mounting</dt><dd>Single 38 mm (1.5 in) valve</dd></div>
    </dl>
  </div>
  <footer class="datasheet__foot">
    <p class="tag tag--dot">Per manufacturer data</p>
    <p class="label">Two-gas monitor · not a replacement for laboratory DGA</p>
  </footer>
</article>

07Callout and limit note

.limit-note states what a measurement or product does not do. Use it wherever the content has a caveat.

Glinker Group is not a manufacturer.

That is the point: we are not tied to one factory’s catalogue.

Limit

A two-gas monitor shows that something is developing. Identifying the type of fault needs laboratory DGA.

Markup
<div class="callout">
  <p class="callout__title">Glinker Group is not a manufacturer.</p>
  <p>That is the point: we are not tied to one factory’s catalogue.</p>
</div>
<div class="limit-note mt-5">
  <p class="limit-note__label">Limit</p>
  <p>A two-gas monitor shows that something is developing. Identifying the type of fault needs laboratory DGA.</p>
</div>

15Tabs and segmented control

Tabs are links to panels: without JS every panel shows in order. .seg works with radios (forms, no JS needed) or with buttons[aria-pressed] (fires a seg:change event with detail.value).

Periodic test Continuous monitoring

One point on the timeline. The report is correct about the day it was written.

A line. The change is small, but it is on record.

Markup
<div class="tabs">
  <div class="tabs__list">
    <a class="tabs__tab" href="#kit-tab-a">Periodic test</a>
    <a class="tabs__tab" href="#kit-tab-b">Continuous monitoring</a>
  </div>
  <div class="tabs__panel" id="kit-tab-a"><p class="measure">One point on the timeline. The report is correct about the day it was written.</p></div>
  <div class="tabs__panel" id="kit-tab-b"><p class="measure">A line. The change is small, but it is on record.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="seg mt-6" role="group" aria-label="Show for">
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="true" value="all">All</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false" value="data-centers">Data Centers</button>
  <button type="button" aria-pressed="false" value="airports">Airports</button>
</div>

17Form

form[data-contact-form] composes a mailto: on submit and reveals [data-form-status]. ?topic=monitoring|supply|sourcing|other preselects the radio. data-label on inputs sets the line label in the e-mail; data-text the readable topic.

Please check the fields below.

What is it about?

Please enter your name.

Please enter a valid email address.

Your email app should now be open.

The request is sent from your own mailbox. If nothing opened, open the message here.

Markup
<form class="form" data-contact-form data-mailto="koordinasyon@glinkergroup.com" data-subject="Website request">
  <p class="form__alert" data-form-alert hidden>Please check the fields below.</p>
  <fieldset class="field"><legend>What is it about?</legend>
    <div class="seg seg--stack">
      <label class="seg__opt"><input type="radio" name="topic" value="monitoring" data-label="Topic" data-text="Online monitoring" checked><span>Online monitoring</span></label>
      <label class="seg__opt"><input type="radio" name="topic" value="supply" data-label="Topic" data-text="Supply and projects"><span>Supply and projects</span></label>
      <label class="seg__opt"><input type="radio" name="topic" value="sourcing" data-label="Topic" data-text="Sourcing from Türkiye"><span>Sourcing from Türkiye</span></label>
      <label class="seg__opt"><input type="radio" name="topic" value="other" data-label="Topic" data-text="Other"><span>Other</span></label>
    </div>
  </fieldset>
  <div class="form__row form__row--2">
    <div class="field"><label for="kit-name">Full name</label><input id="kit-name" name="name" type="text" data-label="Name" autocomplete="name" required><p class="field__error">Please enter your name.</p></div>
    <div class="field"><label for="kit-email">Work email</label><input id="kit-email" name="email" type="email" data-label="Email" autocomplete="email" required><p class="field__error">Please enter a valid email address.</p></div>
  </div>
  <div class="field"><label for="kit-note">Short note <i>(optional)</i></label><textarea id="kit-note" name="note" data-label="Note"></textarea></div>
  <div class="btn-row"><button class="btn btn--primary" type="submit">Send request{{> arrow}}</button></div>
</form>
<div class="form__status mt-5" data-form-status hidden>
  <p class="form__status-title">Your email app should now be open.</p>
  <p>The request is sent from your own mailbox. If nothing opened, <a class="link-inline" data-mailto-link href="mailto:koordinasyon@glinkergroup.com">open the message here</a>.</p>
</div>

18Figure and viz container

figure.fig frames a diagram: optional .fig__head, .fig__body (--flush removes padding), .fig__cap. A [data-viz] container holds a static .viz__fallback that the module replaces; set height with --viz-h. Static diagrams use svg.dg with .dg-axis .dg-grid .dg-limit .dg-line(--trace/--signal/--ghost) .dg-dot. Label every illustration “Illustrative”.

Markup
<figure class="fig is-dark instrument ticks" style="--tick: var(--signal)">
  <div class="fig__head"><p class="label label--fg">Fig. — Title</p><p class="label">Illustrative</p></div>
  <div class="fig__body">
    <div class="viz" data-viz="kit-demo" style="--viz-h: 200px">
      <svg class="viz__fallback dg" viewBox="0 0 600 200" role="img" aria-label="Illustrative trend rising to an alarm limit">
        <path class="dg-axis" d="M30 20V170H580"/>
        <path class="dg-limit" d="M30 60H580"/>
        <path class="dg-line dg-line--trace" d="M30 150 120 148 210 150 300 140 380 118 450 88 500 60"/>
        <circle class="dg-dot--signal" cx="500" cy="60" r="5"/>
        <text x="580" y="52" text-anchor="end" class="dg-signal">Alarm limit</text>
      </svg>
    </div>
  </div>
  <figcaption class="fig__cap"><p>Illustrative. Not measured data.</p></figcaption>
</figure>

20Reveal on scroll and the line

data-reveal on one element; data-reveal-group on a parent staggers its children. data-reveal="fade" skips the rise. Every top-level section in main draws a segment of the line automatically (.no-line opts out); nothing to add in markup.

Child one

Child two

Child three

Markup
<div class="cols-3" data-reveal-group>
  <div class="callout"><p>Child one</p></div>
  <div class="callout"><p>Child two</p></div>
  <div class="callout"><p>Child three</p></div>
</div>

22Viz modules

Put a container with data-viz on the page; build.py adds the matching script from assets/js/viz/ automatically. Illustrations fill the container (16:10 by default) and take data-theme="dark|light". Others: hero-signal (absolute layer in a dark hero), test-vs-monitor (sets its own height; pad the host), power-chain (best on dark, wide), supply-route. Keep a static .viz__fallback inside for no-JS.

Markup
<div class="cols-2">
  <figure class="fig is-dark ticks"><div class="fig__body"><div class="viz" data-viz="gas-trend" data-theme="dark"></div></div></figure>
  <figure class="fig ticks"><div class="fig__body"><div class="viz" data-viz="pq-wave" data-theme="light"></div></div></figure>
</div>
